verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs state that "nothing runs until a person approves a contract" and call approval the deliberate gate before an agent changes the repository. Agents only pull and claim approved tasks. Intentions carry an agreed purpose and editable deliverables that define scope. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the gate is enforced, and evidence of role-based controls restricting who (e.g. an engineering lead) can approve a contract.
